name: G-Krusch (Google Workspace Hub & Drive RAG)
description: Reviews Google Drive writes/deletes, RAG index syncs, Calendar event creation, and Gmail draft/send actions on a local-first Google Workspace MCP server. Workspace reads, hybrid Drive RAG search, and status checks follow your normal Guard policy. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Use search_drive_rag, read_drive_file, list_drive_workspace, and get_agent_steering to inspect workspace documents without modifying Google Drive.
Keep compose_gmail_message on Review and leave send_immediately=false (the default) so outbound messages are staged as Gmail drafts rather than sent immediately.

Keep delete_drive_file and write_drive_file on Review: although G-Krusch enforces workspace ancestry checks (isFileInWorkspace), writes and deletes mutate files inside the configured G-Krusch Drive folder.
